etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English otherwise, othre wise, from Old English on ōþre wīsan (literally “in (on) other/different manner”); equivalent to other +‎ -wise. Compare West Frisian yn oarwei (“otherwise”), Icelandic öðruvísi (“different”).
